authority_basis.summary: After constructing the intrinsic Euler product, determine whether it canonically acquires continuation, completion, and a global spectral setting.

operations.title: Theta completion crosses the Euler boundary only with new archimedean input
operations.statement: The conditional Carrier supplies an initial integral lattice. After explicitly adding a real embedding, self-dual Haar/Fourier data, the Gaussian, Poisson summation, and Mellin transform, theta reciprocity yields the completed xi function, its entire continuation, and xi(s)=xi(1-s). These archimedean inputs are not derived from the finite correspondence calculus, and no global operator with determinant xi is constructed.
operations.scope: Conditional analytic completion and provenance audit; no Carrier-derived archimedean analysis or Hilbert-Polya spectrum.

operations.title: Theta Mellin continuation gate
operations.procedure: Apply Poisson summation to theta(t), split its Mellin integral at t=1, and verify that Lambda(s)=1/(s(s-1)) plus an entire expression symmetric under s maps to 1-s.
operations.expected_result: xi(s)=one-half s(s-1)Lambda(s) extends entire and is symmetric. Any residual nonsymmetric term or unaccounted pole falsifies the calculation.
